title: How to Track Your Hearing Test Results Over Time
description: Keep hearing test results organized, compare audiograms over time, and prepare for appointments with a simple record-keeping routine and practical checklist.
excerpt: A folder of reports is a useful start. Here’s how to turn separate audiograms into a hearing history you can find, compare, and bring to your next appointment.
